# Hackathon management platform

Manage teams with their members, mentor sessions and judge scores.

**teams**: name (string), college (string), city (string), track (AI / Web / Health / Sustainability / Open), project_title (string), stage (Registered / Shortlisted / Finalist / Eliminated). **members**: name (string), email (string), phone (string), role (Leader / Developer / Designer / Presenter). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to teams.
**mentor_sessions**: mentor_name (string), topic (string), date (string), time (string), status (Scheduled / Completed / Cancelled). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to teams. Actions: complete (status = Completed), cancel (status = Cancelled).
**judge_scores**: judge_name (string), innovation (integer), technical_depth (integer), presentation (integer), impact (integer), comments (string). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to teams.

Features:
- Add, edit and delete teams
- Add, edit and delete members
- Add, edit and delete mentor sessions
- Add, edit and delete judge scores
- Filter lists by status or category
- Search by name
- Dashboard with totals and charts

+
+**Goal:** Build a hackathon management platform: teams have name, college, city, track AI/Web/Health/Sustainability/Open, project title and stage Registered/Shortlisted/Finalist/Eliminated; actions: shortlist and eliminate. Each team has many members: name, email, phone and role Leader/Developer/Designer/Presenter. Each team has many mentor sessions: mentor name, topic, date, time and status Scheduled/Completed/Cancelled; actions: complete and cancel. Each team has many judge scores: judge name, innovation 1-10, technical depth 1-10, presentation 1-10, impact 1-10 and comments. Show total teams, members per team, average judge scores, filter teams by stage and track, search teams by name, edit and delete everything.
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+4 SQLite tables (teams and members and mentor_sessions and judge_scores) with one database module each; every module's schema creates all tables. FastAPI routers, one per resource. Counters are owned by the server and change only through action endpoints; lists are ordered by the query field sort. A multi-page app (dashboard, a page per resource, a detail page) is served from static/.

+**judge_scores**: judge_name (string), innovation (integer), technical_depth (integer), presentation (integer), impact (integer), comments (string). Operations: list, create, update, delete. Belongs to teams.

+- Add, edit and delete teams
+- Add, edit and delete members
+- Add, edit and delete mentor sessions
+- Add, edit and delete judge scores
+- Filter lists by status or category
+- Search by name
+- Dashboard with totals and charts

+- `PUT /api/members/{id}`: Edit one member Answers 409 when: Email already exists (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `DELETE /api/members/{id}`: Delete one member
+- `GET /api/teams/{team_id}/mentor_sessions`: List the mentor_sessions of one team
+- `POST /api/teams/{team_id}/mentor_sessions`: Add a mentor_session to a team
+- `PUT /api/mentor_sessions/{id}`: Edit one mentor_session Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).
+- `DELETE /api/mentor_sessions/{id}`: Delete one mentor_session
+- `POST /api/mentor_sessions/{id}/complete`: Complete one mentor_session: sets status to Completed and return the updated mentor_session Answers 409 when: That status change is not allowed (the database refuses it by itself and the app turns that into the 409: never check it in the route function).

+- `GET /api/teams/{team_id}/judge_scores`: List the judge_scores of one team
+- `POST /api/teams/{team_id}/judge_scores`: Add a judge_score to a team
+- `PUT /api/judge_scores/{id}`: Edit one judge_score
+- `DELETE /api/judge_scores/{id}`: Delete one judge_score
+

+- Form to add a team with name, college, city, track, project title, stage

+- Edit and Delete buttons on every team
+- Form to add a member with name, email, phone, role (inside the open parent)
+- Click a team (Comments button) to open its members with a form to add one
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every member
+- Form to add a mentor_session with mentor name, topic, date, time, status (inside the open parent)
